title: A stress test of a browser micro-voxel engine
author: LocoMod
selftext: Been working on optimizing infinite terrain gen for a micro-voxel engine with destruction physics (think like the game Teardown). Optimizing the engine to render far terrain at this detail has been a journey. But I think I'm close. It is 4x the detail of Minecraft. There is more to show in future posts but I have always dreamed of being able to fly above a map in an airship and scout the dangers below. I have yet to find a game that gives me that feeling I pursue.
